import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = {
    'brand': ['Leica', 'Fuji', 'Pentax', 'Olympus', 'Leica'],
    'model_year': [2005, 2019, 2012, 2015, 2016],
    'megapixels': [13.5, 46.4, 38.7, 22.5, 12.2],
    'max_iso': [25600, 51200, 12800, 6400, 25600],
    'weight_grams': [324, 1151, 598, 1095, 290],
    'price_usd': [811.8, 3596.41, 3357.2, 1555.7, 3899.09],
    'sensor_type': ['Micro 4/3', 'APS-C', 'Full Frame', 'APS-C', 'Medium Format'],
    'has_video_4k': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'lens_mount': ['E', 'EF', 'MFT', 'Z', 'MFT'],
    'body_type': ['Compact', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'DSLR']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create a comprehensive visualization with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels scatter plot with brand colors
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
brands = df['brand'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', n_colors=len(brands))
brand_colors = dict(zip(brands, colors))
for brand in brands:
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax1.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
               s=100, label=brand, alpha=0.7, color=brand_colors[brand])
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(fontsize=8)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Weight vs Price
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['weight_grams'], df['price_usd'], 
                     c=df['model_year'], s=150, cmap='viridis', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Price vs Weight (colored by Year)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2, label='Year')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Max ISO by Brand
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
ax3.bar(range(len(df)), df['max_iso'], color=[brand_colors[b] for b in df['brand']], alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(df)))
ax3.set_xticklabels([f"{b}\n{y}" for b, y in zip(df['brand'], df['model_year'])], 
                     fontsize=8, rotation=0)
ax3.set_ylabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Max ISO by Camera', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 4. Sensor Type Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
ax4.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.0f%%',
        startangle=90, colors=sns.color_palette('pastel'))
ax4.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Body Type Distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
ax5.bar(body_counts.index, body_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette('muted'), alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 6. Timeline of releases
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
ax6.scatter(df['model_year'], df['price_usd'], s=df['megapixels']*5, 
           c=[brand_colors[b] for b in df['brand']], alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Price Over Time (size=megapixels)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 7. Specs comparison heatmap
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
numeric_cols = ['megapixels', 'max_iso', 'weight_grams', 'price_usd']
df_norm = df[numeric_cols].copy()
for col in numeric_cols:
    df_norm[col] = (df_norm[col] - df_norm[col].min()) / (df_norm[col].max() - df_norm[col].min())
df_norm.index = [f"{b} ({y})" for b, y in zip(df['brand'], df['model_year'])]
sns.heatmap(df_norm.T, annot=False, cmap='YlOrRd', cbar_kws={'label': 'Normalized Value'},
            ax=ax7, linewidths=0.5)
ax7.set_title('Normalized Specifications Comparison', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Camera Model', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Specification', fontsize=10)

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Comprehensive Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
